visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md (locked 2026-08-11). This route never had a KB-era mockup, which is why this directory holds a contract and no index.html. The target is the six closed patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3.
competitiveTarget: Beat the Zillow and Redfin subdivision pages. First screen is a Ledger of this plat's homes. Giant 0 is forbidden. Empty Ledger if none. Parent community or city is the back door. Schools on the first path. Field only when pins are a real map.
note: REPAIRED 2026-08-14 page-grade v2.4 wrong-grain. Opens a Ledger of this plat's homes. Field only when pinCount >= 4. Giant 0 is forbidden: a timed-out read is an honest empty Ledger, never a 0 hero. The methodology essay is one line (homesLedgerTrace). Parent Tetherow or the city is the ghost action. Schools (SubdivisionSchools) sit immediately after the homes. The old line Places open on Instrument then Field is retired. Value my home is not the opening ask.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: BreadcrumbList + Place JSON-LD, the same two payloads and the same hasMap condition the KB page emitted. ci:ai-structured-data pins this route to MetadataBlock by name.

requiredComponents.name: KbNav
requiredComponents.section: The public header, mounted by app/layout.tsx through PublicNav. Not a page-level import; ci:mockup-parity auto-satisfies this entry while the layout owns the header. The chrome has not migrated, so this route is a mixed page in the ci:public-ui ledger by design.

requiredComponents.name: KbSectionTracker
requiredComponents.section: Page-level analytics, pageType='subdivision', unchanged. Kept on the KB register deliberately: section tracking is analytics wiring, not visual language, the barrel ships no equivalent, and the tracker observes both register roots.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > Communities > (parent resort or parent city) > this plat, the same trail and the same parent rule as the KB page. Surface tone, which also clears the fixed public header by default.

requiredComponents.name: V3Instrument
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 1, up to twice, NEVER the opening. Level 2 is the plat market_stats_cache ytd row when it carries a median or sold count, otherwise the parent pulse below sales history. No giant 0. No Value my home on this band.

requiredComponents.name: V3Field
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 2, only when the plat has enough pins to be a map (FIELD_MAP_MIN = 4). A short plat is a Ledger. The empty state is an empty Ledger, not a Field of ghost tiles.

requiredComponents.name: V3Ledger
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3. The opening for a short plat or an empty plat: homes as rows, or an honest emptyMessage when the query timed out or the plat has none. Parent community or city is the ghost action.

requiredComponents.name: PlaceFieldMap
requiredComponents.section: The real Google map filling V3Field's mapSlot, shared at app/central-oregon/_v3/PlaceFieldMap.client.tsx. Draws the recorded plat polygon and one pin per plotted listing, reads and writes the same highlight as the list through useV3FieldBinding. The route-local SubdivisionFieldMap pair is gone.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSalesHistory
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 3, Ledger, route-local. One row per calendar year of closed single-family sales from the get_subdivision_sales_history RPC, value column the median close price, each row a door into the closed-sales explorer at that year. THE DOOR OPENS THE YEAR IT NAMES: /housing-market/history clamps its year parameter to [1998, 2030], and 7,553 closings across 497 plats predate 1998 (verified live 2026-08-12), so years outside that range get no row and are stated as a count in the note instead of a link that lands on another year's aggregates. The total still covers every year the RPC returned. The range lives in _v3/history-door.ts and ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins it to the destination's own clamp. When every year a plat has is outside the range (2 plats today) the Ledger renders its empty variant with the reason, not nothing. Renders nothing only when the RPC returns nothing, because an empty result there is the absence of an answer rather than the answer zero. ODS rule 5-4 A.4: aggregates only.

requiredComponents.name: SubdivisionSchools
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, Quiet, route-local, and the page's closing section. The assigned schools first, each printing the modal count over the total that carried the field so the section 0 threshold is visible evidence rather than an assertion, then every outbound edge the page carries (parks, trails and golf with their distance and the sentence that says what it measures, the parent places, the peer plats, the browse path, the indexes, and the Oregon Data Share citation). ci:subdivision-stats-integrity requires this component be rendered by name.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6. Field-mode H1 when the plat is map-worthy. SubdivisionSchools is the page's school Quiet and must render by name (ci:subdivision-stats-integrity).

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. The canonical sitemap projection (V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS off lib/site-nav) plus the legal row, carrying no button because the one valuation primary belongs to the sticky header. Rendered OUTSIDE <main>, because HTML-AAM maps <footer> to role=contentinfo only when it is not nested in sectioning content.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to KbNav today. Not in requiredComponents as itself because the gate checks the route file; the KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

jsonLd: BreadcrumbList, from the same trail array V3Breadcrumb renders.
Place, with address and containedInPlace only when the page resolved a city, and hasMap only when a polygon or at least one plotted listing exists.
dataLayer: getGeoBoundaryMapData({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug }) — the plat polygon and its active pins.
getCommunityListings(city, alias, 14) — the registry-name active set. Also the registry-path active count, which is why that path's trace names the fourteen-row ceiling.
getListingTiles({ ..., status: 'active', propertyType: 'A', limit: 200 }) — the Field rows and pins.
getListingsWithVideos({ community, city, status: 'active', limit: 12 }) — marks the Field rows that have a video tour.
getMarketStats({ geoType: 'subdivision', geoSlug: slug, periodType: 'ytd' }) — the market Instrument's first choice. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the period.
getSubdivisionSchools(city, alias) — the closing Quiet's school entries. ci:subdivision-stats-integrity pins the call.

fetchSubdivMarketExtras({ citySlug, resortSlug }) — the community and city pulse rows, of which the market Instrument uses exactly one. READ CONDITIONALLY: it runs only when the plat has no market_stats_cache row of its own, because the band renders the plat row when there is one and both pulse queries would then be discarded. It used to run on every request.
isSubdivisionIndexable(slug) — the robots policy in generateMetadata.
sectionOrder: V3Instrument (parent market, only when plat stats are absent)
